data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2 CONFLICT_RESOLUTION (Stage 3 Task-Design/Completeness expand_vs_reduce): Completeness finding applied — dd-5 bundle (task-5) now includes overall_result + per-DD pass/fail. Story-closure assertion at task-7 SHIFTS from 'dd2.json sc8_pass=true attached' to 'dd5.json overall_result=true attached to epic 4047' — this single assertion proves all 5 DDs passed AND the bundle was committed. The Before/After shape concern is now redundant: dd5.json embeds per-DD pass/fail which captures the dd-2 contract (sc8_pass derives from before/after equality).
